constantValue.defaultValue: What types of insurance products does Bankers Life offer?
Bankers Life offers life insurance, Medicare Supplement and Medicare Advantage coverage, long-term care insurance, supplemental health insurance, and annuities.
Medicare is federal health insurance for people age 65 and older and some younger people who meet eligibility requirements. It helps cover hospital care, doctor visits, and other services.
Medigap policies sold by private insurers can help pay some out-of-pocket costs under Original Medicare, such as deductibles, copayments, and coinsurance.
Where can I access Bankers Life claim forms online?
Visit the Claim Form Requests section of the Bankers Life service and support site to access claim forms.
What is Bankers Life’s hiring process?
Candidates complete an interview before receiving an agent contract. Bankers Life also requires background and drug screening.
